counting: Per-export definition/instance sums, not globally deduplicated resources, draw calls or GPU performance. Each canonical source owner is counted once.

preservation.method: Exact packed PNG bytes and independently decoded 8-bit samples/alpha, metadata and binding/mapping/use-state; unsupported maps fail closed

limits: Standalone CPU/browser/native-UI checks only; game import/camera/playback, GPU cost and artist acceptance remain separate.
Palette-only presentation previews retain ac41b74 source bindings, not final-motion bindings.
